scope: Read-only analysis of exact prior public source and immutable actual reports. No new host request, signal, process, sandbox change, or business replay.

prior_same_runtime_synthetic.binding: Prior successful owned synthetic, not a new observation of installed subprocess.py.

observations: Original sandbox rejected a direct O_RDONLY open of /dev/null with errno=1; patched sandbox allowed that open, character-device check, EOF and close. This is the exact scope of the direct-open comparison.
Patched nested diskutil Popen returned PID 11754 and Commands appended its row. The observed PermissionError is later than that Popen registration.
Commands stores row.custody only after capture_child returns. A null custody therefore leaves multiple possible failing system calls; it is not proof that the first ps_rows call failed.
Both command capture and the once-only cleanup recorded PermissionError. Nested signals=[], directChildReaped=false, allGroupRowsEmptyAfterReap=false, exitCode=null remain unchanged.
The parent top-level three direct children were reaped and empty. That does not establish the nested child's original custody, exit status or reap.
Final source/tool after-fences and the patched child's four kernel-refusal checks were not reached. They are not reported as passed.

source_control_flow.classification: Popen and row registration completed. Failure occurred before capture_child returned.
Calls subprocess.run for /bin/ps with DEVNULL and two pipes. close_fds/start_new_session are omitted and take runtime defaults. Only TimeoutExpired is translated locally.
A normal returned nonzero ps status maps to Refusal (or empty projection then Refusal), not the recorded PermissionError. An OS error thrown inside subprocess.run can propagate unchanged.
Reached only if first ps and scope checks passed. Any OS PermissionError here propagates before custody assignment.

source_control_flow.operation: os.getpgid / os.getsid on the still-live branch
source_control_flow.classification: Only ProcessLookupError is handled. Other OSError subclasses, including PermissionError, propagate. This is a source possibility, not an observation that these calls ran.

source_control_flow.operation: Retained-exit branch repeats waitid and ps
source_control_flow.classification: A later observation can also fail before the final custody object is returned.
Attempts the same capture path within the original TERM1 bound. Its PermissionError leaves unknown and sends no signal. It cannot recover a successful custody from the numeric PID alone.

possible_failure_sites_not_a_root_cause_: Inside the first or repeated ps_rows subprocess.run: DEVNULL/pipe preparation, process creation or exec, communication/wait/close. No ps-specific errno, frame or completed-process record was exposed.
After a successful first ps_rows: WNOWAIT waitid, live getpgid/getsid, or the retained-exit repeat. The current report cannot distinguish these.
The executable's setuid bit is observed metadata and a relevant discriminator for a future narrowly approved diagnostic; it does not establish which sandbox authorization failed.

limited_findings: Upstream v3.14.3 Popen._get_devnull uses os.open(os.devnull, os.O_RDWR) at 1146-1149. The actual direct-open probe used O_RDONLY; diskutil Popen returning is additional evidence beyond that direct-open case.

The upstream Popen default is close_fds=True and start_new_session=False. The posix_spawn branch at 1859-1878 additionally requires the runtime CLOSEFROM capability when close_fds is true, and rejects start_new_session=True.

Thus source-level ps and diskutil invocations have different eligibility: diskutil explicitly requests a new session; ps does not. Actual installed stdlib bytes, capability and branch were not observed.
Upstream run uses Popen and communicate. Exceptions may precede a CompletedProcess, while returned nonzero status is available to the helper's own Refusal checks.
cpython_reference.limitations: The official same-version source is a reference, not a whole-hash qualification of Homebrew's installed standard library or its chosen launch path.

parent_reported_later_observations_not_r.scope: Parent reported PID absent, followed by two numeric-only PGID/PPID/PID projections selecting no rows. These are later observations, not the original missing reap/exit receipt. This author has not reread those host jobs.

proposed_public_fields: stdout/stderr byte counts and hashes only
bounded_diagnostic_design_only.goal: Distinguish the first ps launch from later child-identity system calls without executing any production capture.
prohibited_inference_or_change: Do not call known PermissionError a confirmed setuid or posix_spawn rejection.
Do not add no-sandbox execution, relax file or network policy, disable close_fds, change UID/mode, copy a system binary, or skip retained-child identity guards.
Do not replay R4 or the existing probe. Any later diagnostic needs a separately reviewed source/request, fresh owned path and original deadline contract.
